goal: Translate the learned ONE PIECE product-first editorial system into the deck detail page while keeping Pokémon deck identity and actions intact.

requiredDirection.surface: warm-white map-paper page; navy/black as contained identity and data accents rather than full-page stage
requiredDirection.identity: product-first rectangular deck cover frame paired with title, author, environment and update information
requiredDirection.composition: identity -> restrained description -> ruled stats -> view switch -> collection content -> persistent actions
requiredDirection.geometry: low-radius rectangular panels, 1px rules and bounded media; remove oversized pill/action language
requiredDirection.colorRoles: red primary action, navy structure, yellow sparse attention, preserve purple/price/status semantics
requiredDirection.type: strong short title/numeric values with readable restrained Chinese body

mustNotDo: turn the cover into a ONE PIECE product
let the bottom actions dominate the viewport
change business behavior or other routes
acceptance: 390/536/1280 show identity, description/stats and view/actions in a coherent hierarchy
masked recognition passes through product framing, paper mass, rules and editorial density
all detail actions/viewer/expand controls retain pointer and keyboard outcomes
zero clipping, overflow, external writes or other-route regression
